key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unguarded d.set(nullptr) and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() check in the QCollator caller, whereas (B) adds QThreadStorageData::clear() that does that check inside the API, so (D)'s new public function can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown with nothing left to destroy it (and (D) keeps the qthread_p.h include and a now-misleading comment).
